PZZ700-012030-
1246 AM PDT Sun Nov 1 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 aM, a 1018 mb high was 1000 miles west of San Diego and a 
1005 mb low was 200 miles southwest of San Diego. Weak to moderate
onshore flow will continue through this morning. Winds will 
increase this afternoon and evening with peak gusts of 20 to 25 
knots and rough, choppy seas expected in the outer coastal 
waters. There is also a slight chance of thunderstorms this 
morning as a storm system continues through the region. Weak 
offshore flow in the morning will alternate with afternoon onshore
flow starting Monday.
